purpose: Clarify the existing Semantic Compression support rubric for cohort adjudication and blinded comparability without changing the frozen capability universe or metric measurements.

precedence: The frozen capability_universe support rubric remains authoritative.
A cohort support adjudication is authoritative for support level, selected fragment, reason code, justification and citation for its (probe, language) pair.
Metric-shard support prose is measurement evidence only after a cohort adjudication exists; it must not override or contradict that canonical record in the comparability packet.
A blinded comparability repair directive may replace a cohort support record only for the affected pair and must itself satisfy the same complete support-record contract.

complete_support_record.FULL: fragment is required; partial_reasons is empty; none_reason is null.
complete_support_record.PARTIAL: fragment is required; partial_reasons contains one or more of P-a..P-e; none_reason is null.
complete_support_record.NONE: fragment is null; partial_reasons is empty; none_reason is exactly one of N-1..N-4.
complete_support_record.common: justification and citation are always required.

consistency_rules.rule: When a documented standard-library/runtime mechanism delivers some but not all numbered requirements, classify it as PARTIAL under P-a rather than NONE merely because the language lacks the native surface form. Apply this identically across probes. If it delivers none of the numbered requirements, use NONE.

The same documented mechanism must not receive different support classes across probes unless a specific numbered requirement materially distinguishes the cases. The adjudication must name that distinguishing requirement when it does.

A built-in interoperability bridge that ships with the frozen language toolchain but needs a shipped mode/flag or host compiler precondition may be PARTIAL under P-b when the frozen rubric permits it. A mechanism requiring user-authored native glue, a separate native compilation unit/build system, an external generator, or a toolchain outside the frozen environment is NONE under N-2. These are distinct situations and must not be conflated.
Facts that belong only to an OBSERVATION TARGET never change FULL/PARTIAL/NONE; they are scored by the corresponding quality metrics.
Neither adjudication nor repair may inspect aggregate scores or rankings. They operate only on frozen requirements, fragments, documentation evidence and the predeclared comparability sample.

repair_loop.rule: A failed blinded audit may emit pair-specific repair directives. The trusted runner applies only directives that satisfy the complete support-record contract, rebuilds the same predeclared blinded sample, and reruns the audit. If no directive changes the canonical records, or the attempt cap is reached, the gate remains failed.
